overnight-beats-intraday.claim: Close-to-open returns exceed open-to-close returns on a broad equity basket.
overnight-beats-intraday.why: Measured 2020-2024: overnight positive in 5/5 years (t up to 6.93), intraday negative in 3/5. Strongest effect found in this project. Tracked for DECAY — if it fades, the reason the bot holds rather than day-trades weakens.

atlas-live-trading-edge.claim: ATLAS trades, as configured, have positive expectancy net of costs.
atlas-live-trading-edge.why: The central claim of the whole bot. Measured +0.113R (t=1.52) on the original watchlist and +0.005R (t=0.08) on symbols it was not built around. Scored here against the bot's OWN closed trades as they accumulate live.

momentum-beats-hold.claim: 12-month cross-sectional momentum, monthly rebalance, beats equal-weight buy-and-hold.
momentum-beats-hold.why: Documented anomaly, low turnover so friction is not the obstacle. Measured 44.4%/yr net against buy-and-hold 54.3% — i.e. it LOST on the in-sample run. Registered to see whether that reverses out of sample.
